title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: machine role inputs
description: The rendered terraform.tfvars.json of a TerraformMachine apply (common.md, machine.md). Module inputs are exactly the contract inputs: no other properties.

captf_cluster_outputs.description: The cluster role's exports output, verbatim; {} when the TerraformCluster is externally managed.

bootstrap_data.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the bootstrap Secret's value key, always encoded (machine.md). contentEncoding is an annotation only; the pattern is the assertion.

bootstrap_format.description: The bootstrap Secret's format key; cloud-config when absent.

kubernetes_version.description: Machine.spec.version, verbatim (may carry a +rke2rN suffix), or null.

control_plane.description: True when the owning Machine carries the cluster.x-k8s.io/control-plane label.
